title: 陰XOR陽
author: nahiko
facts: the XOR result as one boolean
description: Three neurons across two layers holding the XOR rule, minted August 2021 as a single-token ERC-721. The artist and the collector each drive one input sphere by writing a boolean to storage, and the contract resolves the two inputs through the network into yin, yang, or their blend. The weights sit in the contract as fixed variables anyone can read; the activation is an integer approximation of a sigmoid built on Babylonian square roots. The forward pass runs entirely in EVM opcodes: isYingYang() computes the network's output inside a static call.

call.note: isYingYang() — runs the forward pass over the two stored inputs and returns the XOR output as a bool
